serviceIdentification.serviceDescription: Cursor is an AI-powered software development platform that helps developers and organizations understand, generate, review, and maintain software. The offering includes the Cursor editor, AI-assisted development workflows, and related cloud services. Anysphere, Inc. is pursuing FedRAMP 20x Class C certification for the Cursor platform, and A-LIGN confirmed on October 22, 2026 that its assessment work was complete. Certification has not yet been granted. Anysphere's FedRAMP 20x Class A application is under FedRAMP review. Origin, Cursor's Git hosting product, is not part of this offering and is not offered to FedRAMP customers; service capabilities that operate on Origin repositories are outside the assessed scope.

trustCenter.repositoryDescription: The Cursor FedRAMP Trust Center provides public program information and access to controlled security and compliance materials.
trustCenter.accessRequestInstructions: Public program information is viewable without an account. To request controlled materials, select Request Access on the Cursor FedRAMP Trust Center and identify your agency or organization. Existing authorized reviewers may use their approved Cursor assessment workspace. For assistance, email fedramp@cursor.com from an official account. Public offering metadata is available as JSON at https://cursor.com/fedramp/certification-package-overview.json.

secureConfigurationGuidance.repositoryDescription: Public guidance for configuring identity, privacy, agent controls, network access, extensions, and monitoring for a secure Cursor deployment.

serviceProperties.securityCategoryNote: The adopting federal agency determines the applicable FIPS 199 security category for its intended use of each service. This package does not assert a provider-wide Low, Moderate, or High impact level.

additionalRepositories.repositoryDescription: The full controlled Certification Package Overview, including the assessor’s Overall Summary of Assessment, and supporting assessment materials are available through Cursor’s authorized assessment workspace.
additionalRepositories.accessRequestInstructions: Existing authorized FedRAMP reviewers may use their approved Cursor assessment workspace and its Certification Package evidence. To request or confirm access, use Request Access on the Cursor FedRAMP Trust Center or contact fedramp@cursor.com from an official account.

certifiedServices.serviceDescription: Cursor IDE is a desktop code editor with AI-assisted code generation, review, navigation, and agent workflows built into the development environment.
supportingCapabilities: Rules, skills, hooks, plugins, and MCP integrations

certifiedServices.serviceDescription: Cursor Agent CLI provides an interactive and headless coding agent in the terminal for writing, reviewing, and modifying code.
supportingCapabilities: Rules, skills, hooks, and MCP integrations

certifiedServices.serviceDescription: Cursor Cloud Agents execute software development tasks in isolated cloud development environments and support parallel, long-running, scheduled, and event-driven workflows.
Cursor SDK provides programmatic access to the Cursor agent runtime for launching, steering, and composing agents in local and cloud environments.
Grok Bot provides AI teammates that work across connected tools using isolated cloud computers, carry tasks from start to finish, and continue working when users are away.
Bugbot reviews source code changes in supported source control systems, reports potential defects, and can propose fixes through Cursor agent workflows.
Security Agents review pull requests and scan codebases for security bugs, risky patterns, and vulnerabilities using Cursor-managed agents that run on Cloud Agents.
PR Routing & Approval routes pull requests to reviewers and approves low-risk changes when configured approval criteria are met.
Enterprise Administration provides organization and team management, identity and access controls, policy enforcement, usage and spend controls, audit and compliance logging, and administrative APIs.

documentationOverview.updateSource: Provider public metadata update: A-LIGN completed its Class C assessment on October 22, 2026. The full Certification Package Overview and assessment materials are shared through the controlled repository. FedRAMP certification has not been granted.
